Construct the Canonical IBSI Phase-1 Digital Phantom

Source: R/radiomics-ibsi.R
ibsi_digital_phantom.Rd

Returns the 4 x 5 x 4 (74-voxel ROI, 2 x 2 x 2 mm voxel spacing) IBSI Phase-1 digital phantom for standardized radiomics verification.

Usage

ibsi_digital_phantom()

Value

A list with voxels (4x5x4 array), mask (4x5x4 integer array), spacing (c(2, 2, 2)), and volume (list(voxels = ..., spacing = ...)).

Examples

ph <- ibsi_digital_phantom()
sum(ph$mask)
#> [1] 74
